title.zh: 宣布每年 12 月 18 日为 Iloilo 市与省的官方公共假日，以纪念 Graciano Lopez Jaena 诞辰的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring December Eighteenth of Each Year an Official Public Holiday in the City and Province of Iloilo to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Graciano Lopez Jaena
title.orig: An Act Declaring December Eighteenth of Each Year an Official Public Holiday in the City and Province of Iloilo to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Graciano Lopez Jaena

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6155_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To commemorate the birth anniversary of our national hero Graciano Lopez Jaena, the eighteenth day of December of each year is hereby declared official public holiday in the City and Province of Iloilo.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
